seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms, takes courier jobs, and investigates the Ugathal/Blackline conspiracy — becoming Magical Crimes Convox consultants before descending into the Widdershins sewers and uncovering Master Grayson's necromantic experiments in an underground Victorian Fane.

seasons.title: Rainbow's End
seasons.arc_summary: A disastrous ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead. Johnny and Benny are resurrected by Aut in the Black and White void (losing Argyle permanently), and the reformed party — joined by Sir Arctos — hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn, discovers the six Thessian gods invading Færrin, and learns of the cosmic Narrative from the rescued Anaïs.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The party enters a keystone scavenger hunt at a mysterious Pilgrimage gathering, builds alliances across Hallia's factions, and uncovers a vast conspiracy to crack the firmament — culminating in the bombing of Teller's Run and the Harlequin's announcement of the Strider's departure.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Boarding the colossal Strider, the party builds their Fane, navigates the deadly weekly Tithe, forges an alliance with the ancient Machine God deep in the Undercroft, and accidentally destroys the Menhir — flinging the Strider far starward to a dead world with catastrophic consequences for all aboard.

seasons.title: Stranded
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded on a scoured world far from home, the party rallies surviving factions, recruits the freed gunslinger Egan, assaults the corrupted Harlequin spire, pursues Anzu's sister Galzu through surreal memory-vignettes, and discovers a potential way forward at the abandoned Hesperid 3 mining outpost.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Quorum on the Joker World
seasons.arc_summary: Four high-ranking Scale operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure. They battle through fiend-infested ruins, infiltrate the Quorum — a demonic installation built atop a bloodfall portal — and descend into its depths to rescue Voice of Many, a trapped divine heart and grandchild of the Judge, fighting a desperate multi-wave defense to free it and escape back to Scale headquarters.

seasons.title: Into the Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: The Convox investigates a wave of husk-murders in the logging town of Wrenford, following a feyrock necklace into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse. They battle forest predators, rescue a lost child named Tommy, and ultimately confront the fey Court of Masks — only to learn their suspect is already dead and the huskification curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The investigation pivots back to the city of Hallia as the Convox traces fey stone to a jeweler's conference and a mysterious black-raimented figure's apartment, where they discover the Gloaming Codex — a ritual book that transmutes bodies into fey stone. When a crime scene investigator accidentally activates the book, the entire party is pulled into its pages to fight for their lives against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Sedecium Missions
seasons.arc_summary: A Sedecium fire team — Old Man Scrazzy, Lieutenant Foral, and Ozzie — investigates a derelict orbital station sinking into the slip, uncovering evidence that the Thessian Esoterica accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core, then undertakes a daring raid through the Slip to steal divine essence from the freshly-killed Thessian god 'Tithe' before the God Eater Harrow devours it entirely.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
